en: Hand-colored vintage postcard showing an indoor hot spring fountain erupting in a grand glass-and-iron hall. Elegant visitors in late 19th–early 20th century clothing and staff in white uniforms stand around a large circular basin from which a strong jet of water rises. The architecture features tall arched windows with decorative stained-glass elements. Printed German text identifies the scene as the 'new spring' in Karlsbad.
